summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a profound lecture on the Islamic principle that Allah has given each person only one heart, emphasizing the spiritual and practical implications of this reality. He explains that the heart is the seat of intention, morality, and true understanding—distinct from the brain's computational functions. Sh. Ali Mashhour uses this principle to address a critical choice every Muslim must make: whether to prioritize the hereafter or this worldly life. He stresses that these two paths are fundamentally incompatible, and Muslims cannot genuinely commit to both simultaneously, drawing on prophetic traditions about the consequences of each choice.
suggested_title: The One Heart: Choosing Between This Life and the Hereafter
catchy_title: One Heart, Two Lives: Which Will You Choose?
